title: ExpandButton
description: A BRAND-FILLED ICON THAT GROWS ITS LABEL WHEN THE POINTER ARRIVES. At rest it is a circle carrying one glyph; on hover, on focus and while `expanded` is set it widens into a pill and the words appear.
